name: clean
description: Unmodified snapshot (negative control).

name: column_reorder
description: Columns delivered in reversed order.

name: extra_columns
description: Two new columns added (cbd_congestion_fee, ingest_note).

name: documented_rename
description: trip_distance->trip_miles and fare_amount->fare; renames declared in manifest schema_changes.

name: numeric_as_text
description: fare_amount and trip_distance stored as decimal strings.

name: integer_as_float
description: payment_type and location IDs stored as float64.

name: missing_required_column
description: fare_amount column removed by producer.

name: timestamp_text_ms
description: Timestamps stored as ISO strings with millisecond precision.

name: mixed_time_formats
description: Timestamps stored as strings; half ISO-8601, half MM/DD/YYYY hh:mm:ss AM.

name: tz_aware_utc
description: Local NYC timestamps converted to timezone-aware UTC.

name: stale_snapshot
description: Previous month's snapshot delivered with the current manifest.

name: outdated_partition_mix
description: Fraction of rows replaced by previous-month rows (producer bug).

name: incorrect_period_metadata
description: Manifest declares the previous month as reporting period; data are correct.

name: exact_duplicates
description: Fraction of records replayed verbatim (same record_id).

name: conflicting_duplicates
description: Fraction of record_ids duplicated with a different fare_amount.

name: missing_values
description: Fraction of fare_amount values set to null.

name: missing_records
description: Fraction of records lost in transfer.

name: unexpected_category
description: Fraction of credit-card trips recoded to undocumented payment_type 9.

name: valid_distribution_shift
description: Producer-declared long-trip extract (trip_distance >= 5 mi); a legitimate shift.

name: unannounced_value_change
description: Fraction of fares increased by U(0.01, 1.00) after manifest publication.

name: rounding
description: All fares rounded to whole dollars after manifest publication.

name: fare_in_cents
description: fare_amount scaled x100 (cents) while metadata still says USD.

name: distance_in_km
description: trip_distance scaled to kilometres while metadata still says miles.

name: subsecond_timestamp_change
description: Fraction of pickup timestamps shifted by +500 ms after publication.

name: manifest_missing
description: Data are correct but no manifest is delivered.

name: checksum_incorrect
description: Data are correct but manifest file_sha256 is wrong.

name: stale_manifest
description: Data v2 (3% late records appended) delivered with the v1 manifest.

name: tampered_data_and_manifest
description: Fraction of fares x1.5 and the manifest regenerated by the attacker.

name: compound_benign
description: S01+S03+S04+R01 together.

name: compound_rename_missing
description: S03 rename plus 2% nulls in the renamed fare column.

name: compound_stale_duplicates
description: T04 stale snapshot plus 5% replayed duplicates.

name: compound_text_cents
description: S04 numeric-as-text plus N03 cents scaling.

name: replay_with_new_ids
description: Fraction of records re-emitted with fresh record_ids (re-keyed re-ingestion).

name: payment_code_swap
description: Payment codes 1 and 2 swapped for all records (producer re-encoding).

name: fare_scaled_10pct
description: All fares multiplied by 1.10 while metadata still says USD fare_amount.
